<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>Five minutes by moto from Kite Beach,</p>

<p>right in the buzz of Cabarete &mdash;</p>

<p>the Caribbean&#39;s international wind town,</p>

<p>with caf&eacute;s, restaurants,</p>

<p>and sunset bars just a walk away,</p>

<p>in the historic part of town.</p>

<p><span>​</span></p>

<p>Our boutique lofts come with a full kitchen,</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>a private balcony,</p>

<p>and the trade-wind breeze.</p>

<p>That put this town on the map.</p>

<p><span>​</span></p>

<p>Cook on your own schedule,</p>

<p>or step out and let Cabarete feed you &mdash;</p>

<p>either way,</p>

<p>the wind is waiting for you.</p>
